premises.text: Current wearable devices are more motivators than professional tools for tracking performance.
premises.evidence_span: But let's be point blank about these devices. They are more motivators than real professional tools.

premises.text: GPS technology is not precise enough for certain sports performance measurements.
premises.evidence_span: GPS is not precise enough. GPS has got an inaccuracy of 15 feet, if you're lucky.

premises.text: Multiple observation points are necessary for accurate real-time performance tracking in sports.
premises.evidence_span: you need to track two different points. You need to track your wrist, your swing, and your position, acceleration, and speed on the court.

premises.text: The QUASP device provides inch-accurate positioning technology for sports tracking.
premises.evidence_span: the only device with which you can do that, in which you can have multiple observation points, as well as an inch-accurate positioning response, that's the QOSP.

premises.text: The QOSP technology uses differential GNSS positioning to improve accuracy.
premises.evidence_span: Signals are received by the QOSP devices and the QOSP access point, which fuses the motion readings and corrects the satellite signal using the technique called differential GNSS positioning.

premises.text: Bistar has a competitive advantage due to its patents on sensor networks and positioning systems.
premises.evidence_span: Bistar owns several patents on sensor networks, on our indoor and outdoor positioning system.

premises.text: There is a market need for technological solutions in team sports for real-time analysis and injury prevention.
premises.evidence_span: there is no technological solution for teams. There is no technological solution for real-time tactic analyzer, or for injury prevention, or even for talent scouting.

value.text: Athletes can achieve better performance through precise tracking and analysis.
value.evidence_span: Tracking your development is the answer for those who want to achieve a goal.

notes: No separate premises for the applications of QOSP technology as they are implied within the main claims.
